features.title: Explore Sikkim's Monasteries
features.description: Discover the rich heritage, living culture, and Himalayan landscapes of Sikkim.
features.long_description: From AI-powered planning to 24/7 safety, we've got you covered at every step of your cultural and spiritual exploration of Sikkim.

kora.title: Kora, your AI circuit guide
kora.description: Ask anything about Sikkim's monasteries — routes, festivals, etiquette, history — and get grounded answers in seconds.

virtual_tours.title: 360° Virtual Tours
virtual_tours.description: Step inside all four monasteries with guided panoramas, hotspots and audio narration.

heritage.title: Heritage Trails
heritage.description: Every monastery pinned on an interactive map of Sikkim, with live conditions.

culture.title: Monastic Culture
culture.description: Experience the rituals, dances, and living traditions of Sikkim's monasteries.

community_wall.title: Community Wall
community_wall.description: Connect with fellow travelers, share experiences, and discover hidden gems recommended by locals.

emergency_assistance.title: Emergency Assistance
emergency_assistance.description: 24/7 safety support with SOS button, emergency contacts, and real-time location sharing for remote areas.

condition_report.title: Report a Condition Issue
condition_report.description: Spot damage, erosion, or overcrowding at a monastery? Submit a report and help Sikkim's heritage authorities prioritize restoration.
